name: Andru filius Astrolabe
description: Primus of House Jerbiton, leader of the Covenant of Valnastium, who runs an intelligence network and a 'charm offensive' to have the Church accept Hermetic magic.

name: Crucifixio
description: Andru's black cat familiar, a member of the Black Lineage, who could talk before he was bound.

name: Astrolabe
description: Parens of Primus Andru and of Bronwyn, a Jerbiton magus.

name: Constance filia Frederich et Vortimer
description: Lesser Secundus of House Jerbiton at Valnastium, over 130 years old, trained as a Verditius follower and a leading Crafter who builds grand laboratories.

name: Vortimer
description: Constance's adoptive parens, a senior member of the lineage of Carolinus.

name: Angela filia Constance
description: Valnastium maga who crafts magical musical instruments, a Crafter, and acts as the covenant's factor at the Midsummer Fair.

name: Sourdine filia Bronwyn
aliases: Lord Roland of the Val Gardenia
description: House Jerbiton's finest spy, Gently Gifted and a silent caster, one of the Primus's closest confidants who can appear as Lord Roland of the Val Gardenia.

name: Sirocco filia Andru
description: Andru's filia, coordinating House Jerbiton's push into Islamic North Africa and investigating the fate of a lost covenant near Tunis.

name: Grazia filia Natura
description: Animál specialist who supervises Valnastium's stables, kennels and mews and is beginning to investigate taming griffins.

name: Kalliope filia Bibliophilus
description: Middle-aged magus, latest in an intermittent line of librarian-magi at Valnastium.

name: Bronwyn filia Astrolabe
description: Valnastium maga researching Hermetic phonotactics and metered spells, whose poetry is embarrassing doggerel.

name: Larta
description: The first Jerbiton to publicly acknowledge she could not cast spells; her name is now used for such members of House Jerbiton.

name: Josephine
description: Larta magus chef at Valnastium from the Engadine valley, whose food is as good as magical.

name: François
description: Elderly, powerful Larta blacksmith of the Village of the Vale whose smithy is intensely magical and whose kin serve as grogs across the Order.

name: Chloe
description: Valnastium's chief minstrel, a composer of ethereal choral prayers that are magical when performed by others; possibly a unique Natural Magician.

name: Carmine filia Susannah
description: Follower of Flambeau of Iberian ancestry, Andru's model, mistress and wife, the only non-Jerbiton magus living permanently at Valnastium; a member of the lineage of Abydaros.

name: Susannah
description: Carmine's Flambeau parens.

name: Jerbiton
description: Founder of House Jerbiton, of Roman descent, who laid out Valnastium's gardens and ensured regular sacraments in the valley.

name: Saint Cyprian
description: Pre-Hermetic magus saint to whom Valnastium's main church is dedicated, often confused with Saint Cyprian of Carthage.

name: Adam
description: Biblical first man to whom God granted dominion over the Earth; Andru believes the Dominion is mediated through this gift.

name: Díedne
description: Founder whose followers reputedly attacked a community of fifteen druids at Domleschg.

name: Sabina
description: Powerful Flambeau maga of Lukerbad in the previous century who disappeared; her laboratory has never been found.

name: Pontius Pilate
description: Unquiet spirit for whom Mount Pilatus is named, who punishes climbers with terrible weather; harvesting vis from his ghost was outlawed.

name: Hannibal
description: Carthaginian general who held a council of war at the Cirque d'Annibal before marching into Italy.

name: Bishop Werner of Straussburg
description: Ancestor of the Hapsburgs who built the castle of Hapsburg in the 11th century.

name: Berthold V, Duke of Zähringen
description: Founder of Berne in 1191, who named it after a bear he killed.

name: Berthold IV
description: Zähringer who founded Fribourg in 1157.

name: Artio
description: Bear goddess worshipped by the ancient Celts of the Berne region.

name: Saint Meinrad
description: Hermit saint murdered at Einsiedeln in 861, whose tamed ravens followed his murderers.

name: Saint Hildegarde
description: Abbess of Zurich who gave Saint Meinrad a figurine of the Virgin.

name: Ida of Unspunnen
description: Last heir of the Unspunnens, stolen away by Rudolph of Wadenschwyl, sparking war with the Zähringers.

name: Rudolph of Wadenschwyl
description: Knight allied to the Zähringers who eloped with Ida of Unspunnen.

name: Burkland, Count of Unspunnen
description: Count of Unspunnen and foe of the Zähringers who established annual games at Interlaken.

name: Harder Man
description: Possessed monk turned to stone as a face on Mount Harder, looking over the Oberland.

name: Attila the Hun
description: Said to have founded the castle of Spietz.

name: Gargantua
description: Giant credited with throwing the Pierres de Niton and digging Lac Léman.

name: Charles the Fat
description: Emperor buried in the Munster Church of Reichenau in 888.

name: Charlemagne
description: Frankish emperor linked to spurious Reichenau treasures, a Danube-Main canal attempt, and the conquest of Bavaria.

name: Laurens
description: Dwarf king who rules the Rosegarten regio and cursed his roses to appear as stone.

name: Saint Beatus
description: British saint who converted the Jungfrau region and evicted a dragon from his cave.

name: Saint Bernard
description: Canonized founder of the Saint Bernard hospice monastery in 962, patron of Alpine travelers.

name: Saint Nicholas of Myra
description: Saint to whom each house of Saint Bernard was originally dedicated.

name: Gallus
description: Celtic monk from Iona whose hermitage grew into the monastery and town of Saint Gallen.

name: Constantine the Great
description: First Christian emperor who raised a column in Saint Bernard's Pass in 339 to replace a statue of Jupiter Penninus.

name: Saint Maurice
description: Christian soldier martyred in 302 for refusing to worship Roman gods; his ring is a powerful relic.

name: Frederick II
description: Holy Roman Emperor who gained control of Zurich in 1218 and is ally of the Schwytzers.

name: Danu
description: River goddess of tremendous power embodying the Danube and other rivers; in Faerie she is queen of the River.

name: Herakles
description: Hero said to have killed the lindworm near Klagenfurt.

name: Saint Wolfgang
description: Priest who founded a church in the Abersee valley in 976 where his axe fell and defeated the Devil.

name: Paxon of Verditius
description: Verditius magus who currently holds the right to harvest vis from Staubbach Fall.

name: Julius Caesar
description: Roman consul given command of the Alps in 59 BC who defeated the Helevetii.

name: Drusus
description: Roman who conquered Bavaria in 15 BC.

name: Otto I
description: Emperor who recaptured Bavaria in 947 and defeated the Magyars at Lechfeld in 955.

name: Geza
description: Newly Christian King of the Magyars who made peace with Otto in 973.

name: Saint Stephen of Hungary
description: Geza's son, who married Gisela of Bavaria in 996.

name: Gisela
description: Daughter of Henry of Bavaria who married Stephen of Hungary.

name: Henry the Lion
description: Duke from whom Frederick I confiscated Bavaria in 1180.

name: Frederick I
description: Emperor who granted Bavaria to Otto von Wittlesbach in 1180.

name: Otto von Wittlesbach
description: Count Palatine granted Bavaria in 1180.

name: Marchio Liutpoldos
description: Nobleman made overlord of the East March in 976, progenitor of the Babenbergs.

name: Conrad the Salian
description: Emperor whose empire absorbed the Kingdom of Burgundy in 1033.

name: Saint Sylvester
description: Saint said to have slain the Leviathan dragon on New Year's Day 1000, possibly Pope Sylvester II.

name: Pope Sylvester II
description: Pope widely thought to be a magician, possibly the Saint Sylvester who slew the Leviathan.

name: Trivia
description: Threefold goddess of the roads, whose marble statue stands in a redcap exchange regio near Eisenstadt.

name: Jupiter Penninus
description: Pagan deity whose statue in Saint Bernard's Pass Constantine had destroyed.

name: House Jerbiton
description: Hermetic House centred at Valnastium, pursuing a charm offensive toward the Church and hostile to faeries.

name: House Verditius
description: Hermetic House of craft magi; Constance and Angela were trained in its tradition, and it supports the Larta magi.

name: House Merinita
description: Faerie-oriented House that dislikes Jerbiton views of faeries; dominates Journeys End and suffered a civil war.

name: House Bonisagus
description: Hermetic House some of whose members study Larta techniques and the Dolomite regio.

name: House Mercere
description: House of Redcaps, owners of the Copper Rooster inn, hiding behind a mundane merchant house.

name: House Tremere
description: Hermetic House; one member was Marched for trying to steal Heiligenblut's holy blood.

name: House Díedne
description: Destroyed House said to have performed human sacrifices at the Pierres de Niton.

name: House Tytalus
description: Hermetic House whose purge destroyed settlements in Savoy.

name: House Flambeau
description: Hermetic House of Carmine and of Sabina of Lukerbad.

name: House Bjornaer
description: Hermetic House that would be interested in the talking bears of Berne.

name: House Criamon
description: Hermetic House whose members investigated the Augsburg catacombs.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The Hermetic order of magi to which the covenants and Houses belong.

name: Greater Alps Tribunal
description: The Hermetic tribunal covering the Alps, Bavaria and the eastern marches.

name: Grand Tribunal
description: Order-wide tribunal before which chefs gather to prepare a banquet under a promoscundus.

name: Transylvanian Tribunal
description: Neighbouring tribunal that includes the northern plains of Burgenland.

name: Valnastium
description: Ancient Jerbiton covenant and House seat in a Christian valley with a low aura, famed for its library and gardens.

name: Belaquin
description: Covenant in Provence whose grog sold Angela a club of faerie-forest wood.

name: Durenmar
description: Covenant that often has magician-librarians.

name: Verdi
description: Covenant that often has magician-librarians.

name: Covenant of the Icy North
description: Motherhouse hosting the Midsummer Fair and claiming Rego vis from the Domleschg oak grove.

name: Covenant Where Journeys End
description: Ancient mostly-Merinita covenant in Savoy that claims many vis sources and is allied to the Dachstein giants.

name: Covenant of the Sinews of Knowledge
description: Covenant hidden behind a minor cataract feeding the Danube.

name: Covenant of Tarragon Vale
description: Covenant near Schwyz whose magi underwent the Vanishing Away.

name: Rorschach Chapter
description: Chapter of the Covenant of the Icy North with extensive property in Vienna.

name: Black Lineage
description: Magical strain of black cats resident at Valnastium, descended from generations of cat familiars, with a feline hierarchy.

name: Urbastis cult
description: Cult known through Legend Lore to the familiar Crucifixio.

name: Lineage of Carolinus
description: Mystery lineage of which Vortimer is a senior member.

name: Craft School
description: Hermetic movement prizing beautiful and functional objects, whose members (Crafters) are mostly mage-smiths.

name: Lineage of Abydaros
description: Mystery lineage to which Carmine belongs.

name: Meistersingers
description: New German minstrel tradition spreading joy via cynical parodies of nobility and Church.

name: Ierbii
description: Name the Rhaetian-speaking covenfolk of Valnastium call themselves.

name: Legion of Mithras
description: Mystery cult whose Alpine meeting place lies near Martigny.

name: Moorish magicians
description: Shadowy tradition of North African magicians with tentative links to Jerbiton magi of Iberia.

name: Quaesitores
description: Hermetic investigators who examined the Augsburg catacombs.

name: Shadow Flambeau
description: Faction whose rise was a past Hermetic crisis.

name: Seekers
description: Magi who explore ruined Hermetic settlements, drawn to Savoy.

name: Abbaye des Vignerons
description: Guild-like society of Vervay dedicated to viticulture, holding a festival every 15-20 years.

name: Hapsburgs
description: Noble family named after the castle of Hapsburg in Vindonossa.

name: House of Zähringen
description: Now-extinct noble family, founders of Berne and Fribourg, who tried to unite the Alps.

name: House of Savoy
description: Noble house ruling Savoy and building castles near Fribourg and Geneva.

name: Unspunnens
description: Noble family that ruled much of the Oberland, ending with the heiress Ida.

name: Kyburgers
description: Noble family with a home castle near Winterthur and about 100 vassal castles.

name: Kirburgers
description: Relatives-by-marriage who inherited the Zähringer lands, the most powerful indigenous nobles of the Western Alps.

name: Babenbergs
description: Ruling family of Austria and Styria, descended from Marchio Liutpoldos.

name: Hohenstaufens
description: Dynasty that received most of the Swabian pretender's lands.

name: Wittlesbachs
description: Ruling family of Bavaria who gained the Rhenish Palatinate in 1214.

name: Benedictines
description: Monastic order with abbeys at Einsiedeln, Pfeffers, Reichenau, Saint Bernard, Melk and elsewhere.

name: Magyars
description: People who raided Bavaria until defeated at Lechfeld in 955.

name: Helevetii
description: Celtic tribe defeated by Caesar and resettled in the Alpine passes.

name: Alemanni
description: Tribe that settled the Alps roughly matching Bavaria, forming Alemmania.

name: Burgundians
description: Tribe settled in what is now Savoy.

name: Schwytzers
description: People of Schwyz whose sudden appearance is linked to the Vanishing Away of Tarragon Vale.

name: Domleschg druids
description: Community of 15 druids at Domleschg who resisted Díedne.

name: Church
description: The Christian Church, whose declaration Andru seeks that Hermetic magic is enchantment.

name: Larta Magi
description: Members of House Jerbiton unable to cast spells, virtuoso artists played as Mythic Companions.

name: Mythic Companion
description: Character design framework from Hedge Magic used to build Larta magi.

name: Chef
description: Folk magician using Free Expression, Knack and Craft Lesser Charm to cook magical food.

name: Smith
description: Magical blacksmith imbued with properties of iron, a village hedge magician using Natural Magic.

name: Minstrel
description: Musician using almost-magical music to affect emotions.

name: Muse
description: +1 Virtue: grants or enhances Free Expression in an artist while present.

name: Redcap
description: Messenger of House Mercere; retired redcaps lodge at the Copper Rooster.

name: Promoscundus
description: Title of the chef chosen as master of all chefs catering for the Grand Tribunal.

name: Natural Magician
description: Practitioners of Natural Magic who collect objects of Virtue, disliked by Crafters.

name: Primus
description: Head of a Hermetic House.

name: Greater Secundus
description: Second-ranking officer of House Jerbiton, who does not live in the Valley.

name: Lesser Secundus
description: House Jerbiton officer who must remain at Valnastium.

name: Veil of Invisibility
description: Spell used as the model for Crucifixio's primary familiar power.

name: Panic of the Trembling Heart
description: Spell on which Crucifixio's secondary power is modelled, reversed to make people love cats.

name: Banner of Winter
description: Artifact the Dachstein giants desire, letting them travel in the summer lands for extended periods.

name: Ring of Saint Maurice
description: Powerful relic held by the archbishop of Salzburg, said to make one undefeatable in battle.

name: Holy Blood of Heiligenblut
description: Vial of the blood of Jesus held in the church of Heiligenblut.

name: Dragon's licking stone
description: Rock in a dragon cave that ends hunger when licked; House Mercere would pay handsomely for it.

name: Emerald of Charlemagne
description: A 28-pound 'emerald' of glass at Reichenau, among many spurious relics.

name: Skull of the lindworm
description: Skull of the lindworm kept by the people of Klagenfurt.

name: Tatzelwurmli
description: Monstrous limbless land dragon in the Aare Gorge whose lair no covenant can harvest.

name: Basilisk
description: Monster that hatches often in Basel; one hatched in Vienna in 1212.

name: Barbegazi
description: Small blue male gnomes of Pilatus with huge ski-like feet and weather powers (Faerie Might 20).

name: Folly Spirit
description: Alpine spirits inhabiting buildings that drive castle-building to lay eggs, perhaps eating ghosts.

name: Blizzard demons
description: Alpine demons that cause blizzards, break travelers' faith and slay them.

name: Dragon
description: Creatures common in Alpine lore; in Vorarlberg linked to tempests and avalanches.

name: Dragonet
description: Small, quick fire-breathing dragon with corrosive blood.

name: Venedigers
description: 'Men from Venice', a type of faerie in Vorarlberg.

name: Fanes
description: Faeries who ruled a kingdom in the Ticino valley and await vengeance.

name: Giants of Dachstein
description: Giants in a regio behind the Dachstein ice caves, aligned to Magic, allies of Journeys End.

name: Salvani
description: Tribe of gnomes who wove moonlight into the Dolomites, turning them white.

name: Lucent Faeries
description: Moon faeries of great interest to Alpine magi.

name: Lucifugus
description: Creature suspected of lairing in the Werfen ice caves.

name: Ice wyrm
description: Monster that hibernates between feeds, another suspect for Werfen.

name: Lindworm
description: Dragon near Klagenfurt with a taste for virgins, slain by Herakles.

name: Leviathan
description: Gigantic dragon slain by Saint Sylvester, said to stretch beneath the Alps.

name: Nymphs
description: Water nymphs, once Danu's handmaidens, dwelling in jeweled grotto regiones.

name: Tuatha de Danu
description: Danu's children, forced to become reclusive beneath the earth.

name: Faerie
description: Creatures Jerbiton considers soulless parasites that steal human creativity.

name: Succubus
description: Demon posing as a faerie partner.

name: Griffin
description: Magical beast Grazia hopes to tame.

name: Molosser
description: Large Roman dogs forming the basis of the St. Bernard breed.

name: St. Bernard dog
description: Dog breed in its infancy in 1220.

name: Talking bears of Berne
description: Bears of Berne folklore led by a talking bear who saved a prince.

name: Queen of the Herd
description: Champion cow of Martigny's festival, possibly once host of a protective faerie spirit.

name: Summer Faeries
description: Faeries of the Arcadian summer lands who harried the Dachstein giants.

name: Ghosts of Botzberg
description: Spirits of the AD 69 battle that recreate the fight with Hermetic magi.

name: Demon
description: Infernal beings; many faeries magi meet are disguised demons; devils build bridges.

name: Free Expression
description: Virtue named in the text, associated with Larta chefs, smiths, minstrels or muses.

name: Knack
description: Virtue named in the text, associated with Larta chefs, smiths, minstrels or muses.

name: Craft Lesser Charm
description: Virtue named in the text, associated with Larta chefs, smiths, minstrels or muses.

name: Craft Greater Charm
description: Virtue named in the text, associated with Larta chefs, smiths, minstrels or muses.

name: Busybody
description: Virtue named in the text, associated with Larta chefs, smiths, minstrels or muses.

name: Venus's Blessing
description: Virtue named in the text, associated with Larta chefs, smiths, minstrels or muses.

name: Gossip
description: Virtue named in the text, associated with Larta chefs, smiths, minstrels or muses.

name: Patron
description: Virtue named in the text, associated with Larta chefs, smiths, minstrels or muses.

name: Protection
description: Virtue named in the text, associated with Larta chefs, smiths, minstrels or muses.

name: Heal
description: Virtue named in the text, associated with Larta chefs, smiths, minstrels or muses.

description: Virtue named in the text, associated with Larta chefs, smiths, minstrels or muses.

name: Exceptional Strength
description: Virtue named in the text, associated with Larta chefs, smiths, minstrels or muses.

name: Large
description: Virtue named in the text, associated with Larta chefs, smiths, minstrels or muses.

name: Weather Sense
description: Virtue named in the text, associated with Larta chefs, smiths, minstrels or muses.

name: Enduring Constitution
description: Virtue named in the text, associated with Larta chefs, smiths, minstrels or muses.

name: Long-winded
description: Virtue named in the text, associated with Larta chefs, smiths, minstrels or muses.

name: Tough
description: Virtue named in the text, associated with Larta chefs, smiths, minstrels or muses.

name: Reserves of Strength
description: Virtue named in the text, associated with Larta chefs, smiths, minstrels or muses.

name: Superior Armaments
description: Virtue named in the text, associated with Larta chefs, smiths, minstrels or muses.

name: Inventive Genius
description: Virtue named in the text, associated with Larta chefs, smiths, minstrels or muses.

name: Magic Item
description: Virtue named in the text, associated with Larta chefs, smiths, minstrels or muses.

name: Carefree
description: Virtue named in the text, associated with Larta chefs, smiths, minstrels or muses.

name: Mimicry
description: Virtue named in the text, associated with Larta chefs, smiths, minstrels or muses.

name: Social Contacts
description: Virtue named in the text, associated with Larta chefs, smiths, minstrels or muses.

name: Troupe Upbringing
description: Virtue named in the text, associated with Larta chefs, smiths, minstrels or muses.

name: Well-travelled
description: Virtue named in the text, associated with Larta chefs, smiths, minstrels or muses.

name: Enchanting Music
description: Virtue named in the text, associated with Larta chefs, smiths, minstrels or muses.

name: Exceptional Communication
description: Virtue named in the text, associated with Larta chefs, smiths, minstrels or muses.

name: Light Touch
description: Virtue named in the text, associated with Larta chefs, smiths, minstrels or muses.

name: True Love
description: Virtue named in the text, associated with Larta chefs, smiths, minstrels or muses.

name: Gently Gifted
description: Virtue named in the text, associated with Sourdine.

name: Silent Casting
description: Virtue named in the text, associated with Sourdine.

name: Heir
description: Virtue named in the text, associated with inheriting the Reichenau faerie wager.

name: Reckless
description: Flaw common among minstrels.

name: Lost Love
description: Flaw linking an artist to a muse so the muse's physical presence is not required.

name: Hunt
description: Ability listed in the text.

name: Intrigue
description: Ability listed in the text.

name: Leadership
description: Ability listed in the text.

name: Legend Lore
description: Ability listed in the text.

name: Occult Lore
description: Ability listed in the text.

name: Order of Hermes Lore
description: Ability listed in the text.

name: Philosophiae
description: Ability listed in the text.

name: Scribe Latin
description: Ability listed in the text.

name: Sing
description: Ability listed in the text.

name: Speak Latin
description: Ability listed in the text.

name: Speak Greek
description: Ability listed in the text.

name: Survival
description: Ability listed in the text.

name: Stealth
description: Ability listed in the text.

name: Swim
description: Ability listed in the text.

name: Theology
description: Ability listed in the text.

name: Brawling
description: Ability listed in the text (covers wrestling).

name: Play
description: Ability listed in the text.

name: Blacksmithing
description: Ability listed in the text.

name: Mentem
description: Form of mind; Sourdine adjusts victims with Mentem spells and Crucifixio holds Mentem vis.

name: Animál
description: Form of animals; Grazia's speciality.

name: Rego
description: Technique; Rego vis is claimed from the Domleschg oak grove.

name: Ignem
description: Form of fire; fern seeds are believed to hold Ignem vis.

name: Imáginem
description: Form of images; Staubbach Fall and the Werfen caves yield Imáginem vis.

name: Auram
description: Form of air; barbegazi have Control Auram powers.

name: Terram
description: Form of earth; barbegazi have Control Terram powers.

name: Dominion
description: The Divine aura which Andru believes is mediated through the gift made to Adam; it suppresses magical auras.

name: Faerie Realm
description: Realm of faeries, including Arcadia and the River of Danu.

name: Magic Realm
description: Realm of Magic, to which giants are aligned and Mount Pilatus may link.

name: Infernal
description: Realm of demons; sorcery is considered infernal in origin.

name: Familiar
description: Bonded magical animal companion; Valnastium magi often keep black cats as familiars.

name: Cords
description: Gold, Silver and Bronze cords measuring a familiar's bond.

name: Bond Qualities
description: Powers granted by a familiar bond, e.g. Mental Communication.

name: Vis
description: Raw magical power in pawns, harvested from sites and creatures.

name: The Gift
description: Magical talent; Andru hopes to show it is a charism given by God.

name: Charism
description: Gift given by God and stamped on the soul; Andru argues the Gift is one.

name: Midsummer Fair
description: Annual fair hosted by the Icy North where magi trade lab texts, animals and goods.

name: Redcap network
description: House Mercere's Hermetic postal and trade network.

name: Necessary Condition
description: Magical requirement such as playing music for some Jerbiton magi.

name: Casting foci
description: Items used by Verditius-trained magi in casting.

name: Natural Magic
description: Magic considered permissible enchantment, used by smiths and chefs, ignoring the Dominion.

name: Hermetic phonotactics
description: Study of the voice as a tool to cast magic, Bronwyn's field.

name: Metered spell
description: Spell whose verbal component is poetry, easier to learn and cast.

name: Jerbiton Gauntlet
description: Gauntlet of House Jerbiton, which Carmine has passed.

name: Aura
description: Supernatural aura strength of a place; Valnastium's is unusually low.

name: Turb
description: Hermetic collective noun for a group of grogs, from contubernium.

name: Grog
description: Covenant soldier; Valnastium grogs work in tent groups of eight.

name: Covenfolk
description: Mundane residents of a covenant.

name: Charm Offensive
description: Andru's campaign to have the Church declare Hermetic magic enchantment rather than sorcery.

name: Regio
description: Hidden supernatural area; Mount Pilatus, Rosegarten and the Dolomites involve regiones.

name: Peripheral Code
description: Tribunal rulings, e.g. pardoning Andru's war against a faerie king.

name: Code of Hermes
description: Law of the Order which constrains Mercere interference.

name: Marched
description: Hermetic punishment inflicted on a Tremere who tried to steal the holy blood.

name: Schism War
description: Hermetic war that destroyed settlements in Savoy.

name: Chapter house
description: Small Hermetic outpost used to gather vis.

name: Faerie Might
description: Supernatural might score of faeries.

name: Atavism
description: One of the oldest forms of magic, by which Mittenwald's master carver role transfers.

name: Taking the Cure
description: Rules for spa treatment relieving minor physical afflictions for three years.

name: Alpine wrestling
description: Strength-based wrestling style of the Alps, covered by Brawling.

name: Vanishing Away
description: Disappearance of Tarragon Vale's magi, linked to the appearance of the Schwytzers.

name: Faustrecht
description: 'Club law' in Rhaetia where rights go to the strongest.

name: Removes
description: Three-course formal dining pattern of Valnastium banquets.

name: Mulsum
description: Honeyed wine served with the first remove.

name: Public vis source
description: Vis source whose harvest rights are traded, like Staubbach Fall.

name: Lab texts
description: Laboratory texts traded at the Fair.

name: Village of the Vale
description: Village at Valnastium where François's smithy is.

name: Library of Valnastium
description: Temple of the Muses moved from Greece; one of the Order's finest mundane libraries that invented the shelf.

name: Gardens of Valnastium
description: Gardens laid out by Jerbiton with snails, dormice, bees, magical plants and funerary monuments.

name: Church of Saint Cyprian
description: Main church of Valnastium's valley, raised with Hermetic magic.

name: Engadine valley
description: Valley from which Josephine hails.

name: Val Gardena
description: Valley in the Dolomites where the Rosegarten can be seen at dusk.

name: Tunis
description: Place near which the last Hermetic covenant in North Africa was founded.

name: North Africa
